when_to_use: golden-era boom-bap / jazz rap, sample-chopped Rhodes loop, Dilla push-pull timing, muted horn hook, 75-95 BPM

defaults.feel: humanized 16th grid, kick pushed ahead, snare dragged behind, 54-62% hi-hat swing

signature_moves: golden-era loop: Dm9 -> G13 -> Cmaj9 -> A7(b9,b13)
chill descending loop: Fmaj9 -> Em7 -> Dm9 -> Cmaj9
dark urban minor: Am9 -> D9 -> Fmaj7 -> E7alt
rootless shells: voice only 3rd+7th+extensions, never the root - bass alone holds root
cadence_options: loop turnaround: land on an altered dominant that spins back to bar 1
no functional final cadence needed - the loop drops out at the outro
avoid: voicing the root on Rhodes or piano while bass also plays it
quantized/on-grid drums - this genre's identity is the push-pull, not precision

hook_archetypes.name: muted-horn-riff
hook_archetypes.rhythm: a short 1-2 bar phrase landing at the end of a 4-bar loop, not a continuous line
hook_archetypes.contour: a smoky, unhurried phrase resolving into the next loop's downbeat

hook_archetypes.name: vocal-chop-accent
hook_archetypes.rhythm: a short sampled vocal landing used as a rhythmic accent, not a melodic statement
hook_archetypes.contour: a single word or syllable placed on an off-beat or loop turnaround
hook_archetypes.first_appears: Hook/Chorus, layered under the horn riff

intro.note_lengths: sparse and filtered; no lead yet

verse.note_lengths: rap flow or lead line sits back, unhurried, with few sustained notes
verse.contour: conversational and rhythm-forward rather than pitch-forward
verse.placement: laid-back and more dragged than other voices

hook.note_lengths: short muted-horn phrase plus vocal-chop accents
hook.contour: smoky and understated, never a long virtuosic line
hook.placement: laid-back, landing at the end of the four-bar loop

breakdown.note_lengths: sparse; drums drop out, only loop and soloist remain
breakdown.contour: open space before the hook returns
breakdown.placement: rubato-adjacent and loosest in the arrangement

drum_skeleton.low_energy: regular-time boom-bap: kick on 1 plus selected syncopations around beats 2-3, snare behind the grid on beats 2 and 4 with a soft ghost note, hi-hat steady swung 8ths
drum_skeleton.mid_energy: hi-hat fills to swung 16ths, ghost snares thicken around the 2-and-4 backbeat, occasional kick pickup
drum_skeleton.high_energy: denser ghost-note snare pattern and open-hat accents, while kick-ahead and snare-behind push-pull remains audible
drum_skeleton.optional_half_time_variant: for a deliberate half-time section only, move the primary snare to beat 3 and label the section half-time explicitly

arrangement_defaults.layout_rules: filtered Rhodes loop opens with vinyl ambience; drums and sub-bass enter together for verse 1; drums drop briefly every 8 bars; hook adds muted horn and vocal chops over the same loop; verse 2 may swap sub-bass for sampled-upright color; breakdown strips to loop, bass, and one solo voice; outro closes the low-pass filter and lets the loop drop out

anti_boredom_rules: drums must never sound quantized - kick-ahead and snare-behind push-pull remains audible
the harmonic loop stays 2-4 bars and hypnotic; vary texture, filtering, and layering instead of lengthening the progression
at least one full drum drop occurs before the final hook or outro
the muted-horn riff returns varied by register or response phrase
keep roots off the harmony instrument; bass alone holds roots

bass_behavior.role: sub-bass root authority under rootless samples
bass_behavior.rhythmic_relationship: selectively locks with the ahead-of-grid kick and leaves space around dragged snares
bass_behavior.density: sparse sustained roots with occasional approach notes
bass_behavior.articulation: long notes with controlled cutoffs before crowded drum events

groove_intent.feel: asymmetric boom-bap push-pull on a swung-sixteenth grid
groove_intent.kick: slightly ahead with variable syncopated placement
groove_intent.snare: behind beats 2 and 4 in regular time
groove_intent.hihat: uneven swung eighths or sixteenths with velocity variation
groove_intent.ensemble_relationship: sub-bass locks selectively with kick while Rhodes and lead sit farther back
optional_variants: explicitly labeled half-time section with primary snare on beat 3

distinguishing_traits: rootless sampled Rhodes loop with sub-bass ownership of roots
muted horn and vocal chops punctuate a verse-hook hip-hop form

blockers: engine belum punya profil groove 'dilla-boom-bap' di GROOVE_LIBRARY
